content.text:
cd /workspace && git add App.js && git commit -m "fix: ensure unique keys for providers list in UI
Root cause: buildProviders expected object array but received string array
from Supabase client, causing all keys to be undefined and duplicate.
Fix: Normalize sources in buildProviders to handle both string arrays
(e.g. ['ticketmaster', 'kulturhuset']) and object arrays with key/label.
Also added formatProviderLabel() for human-readable source names."
[main 48c7da99] fix: ensure unique keys for providers list in UI
 1 file changed, 22 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)
